quandoUsar: Mentions of people in a text, such as authors and reviewers, with `HoverCardProfile` showing photo, role, bio, and numbers.
Avatars or names in a list where the click should stay free to open the profile.
Previews of links or references that help decide before leaving the page.
quandoEvitar: Use `tooltip` for a short text that names or explains a control.
Use `popover` when the content has buttons, links, or fields: the card does not receive focus, so nothing inside it is reachable by keyboard.
Use `citations` for numbered sources inside an AI response.

teclado.acao: When the trigger is focused by keyboard, the card opens right away; when leaving the trigger, it closes.
Closes the card; it only reopens after focus or the pointer leaves the trigger and comes back.

acessibilidade: The card has `role="tooltip"` and, when open, the trigger gets `aria-describedby` pointing to it: the screen reader reads the content as the trigger's description.
Focus never enters the card; keep the content read-only and leave any action on the trigger itself.
On touch, a tap on the trigger opens and closes the card; the profile photo has an empty `alt`, because the name is already in the text.
movimento: The first card waits `openDelay` (500 ms); with another one open recently, the next opens in 80 ms and only fades.
The card grows from the trigger edge: it starts at 96% and 4 px toward the trigger on a no-overshoot spring, and returns from wherever it is if the pointer comes back during the exit.
With “reduce motion” on, the card only fades, the profile rows do not enter in sequence, and the photo does not come out of a blur.
responsivo: The width is 18.5rem, shrinking to the available width, and the card switches sides when it does not fit, with 12 px of clearance from the edge.
notasIA: The child is the trigger and must accept `ref` and receive focus, like a `<button>` or a link; the preview goes in `content`.
Only one card is open at a time across the whole page; there is no need to coordinate the instances.
`HoverCardProfile` accepts `avatar` as a URL or as an element (for example `next/image`) and shows initials without a photo. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/hover-card/hover-card`.
